parsed.main_gap: A sign error in the lower-inequality expansion makes the displayed inference invalid, though correcting one term repairs the proof.

errors.description: The expansion should end with 4(t+c)(c-b), not 4(t+c)(b-c). With the expression as written, inequality (5) does not follow. Reversing that sign makes (5) valid and leaves the rest of the argument correct.

parsed.notes: Apart from this readily repairable algebraic sign error, the iterate argument, nonnegativity of the displacement, partition argument proving constancy, and converse are correct.
